notes.title: The new update upcoming [dev log] - new levels, bosses etc.
notes.notes:
Hey, guys. I come to you with good news. I'm glad to tell you that I finally found time and started working on new levels for my game. While developing this game I didn't expect anyone to like it, I got feedback from you both positive and negative and all of it was very helpful, because feedback from real people helps us to get better and improve our skills and most importantly the product. Thank you for that, I really appreciate your opinion and thank you for buying my game and adding it to your Wishlists (there are already more than 2000 of them). Realizing that someone likes what I do makes me happier.

I would like to tell you what's in store for you in the future update:
 - 20 new levels
 - 2 new bosses
 - 60 new achievements
 - new enemies
 - new traps
 - better visual design of new levels
 - bug fixes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311037/d2ce85577215f7c5d44bb723a494a2e80edd2e71.png

I also want to say that this update will be absolutely free. So far I have only completed the first three levels but I will do my best to finish the add-on as soon as possible. Thanks for playing my game
